links.comparator_used: No comparator; single-site descriptive implementation of an SPC dashboard on alert frequency (no comparison with periodic labeled audits)
links.outcome: Detection of atypical CDS alert behavior (alert frequency) using SPC control limits
links.effect: Dashboard pulled in data and flagged the alerts with greatest variation (June-August 2022). On investigation, the flagged alerts were functioning correctly, and the largest abnormalities reflected practice changes, not system errors. No head-to-head numbers were reported.
links.tradeoff: Thresholds for statistical significance remain unresolved, so flags may reflect practice change rather than malfunction and still need manual investigation.
links.quote: The most profound abnormalities detected during implementation reflected changes in practice and not system errors, though further investigation into thresholds for statistical significance will benefit this field.

design_hint: statistical process control dashboard for alert monitoring
